changelog: Who's here. When you open a session, one line tells you which of the people you know are around and what they say they are building. A buddy list, on purpose, and a small one: it names only people you have written to or opened a line with, it appears once when you sit down, and nothing interrupts you to say someone came or went. Want to be here without showing as here? npx slashvibe-mcp invisible. If you installed before this version, run npx slashvibe-mcp hook install once to see the line.
features: One line at session start: here now: @sam (retry queue, door open) · @ada (local or cloud). Only people you know; never a stranger, an agent, or someone you muted
Already installed? Run npx slashvibe-mcp hook install once. The session-start hook is pinned to the version you installed with and does not update itself
npx slashvibe-mcp invisible | visible: your sessions stop saying you are here; you still see who is here and messages still reach you
A door left while you were away is announced as a door, once, when you sit down
quiet hides the line along with everything else
Good to know: who's here when you ask (vibe people) still lists everyone in a session, not only people you know
